I solved level 3 of task-77edccbb in 18 actions. The human baseline is 31.

**How the level works:**
- There are two rings of 14 coloured tiles each. The rings share two tiles, at (30,22) and (30,34).
- A click on the left bottom shape (24,41) turns the left ring one step counterclockwise. A click on the right bottom shape (36,41) does the same for the right ring.
- To win, put the `bb` tile in the left slot marked by `b` dots (15,28), and the `cc` tile in the right slot marked by `c` dots (45,28).

**What I did:**
- My first click, on a normal tile, did nothing. The next 2 clicks, one on each bottom shape, showed how the rings turn.
- Then I moved each target tile through a shared tile into the other ring: 3 left turns, 3 right turns, 6 left turns, then the right turns until the level completed.

I saved these rules and the move order as a global memory (`arc_77edccbb_l3_solved`), so later instances of this game can use them.
